**Summary of all 16 views:**

The test image shows a tomato stem split open longitudinally with extensive brown/tan pith discoloration throughout the interior, while the outer green cortex remains intact. Wilted dead leaves and black plastic mulch visible in background.

**Best match: Southern_Bacterial_Wilt** - Reference (1568041) showed an almost identical appearance: stem split lengthwise with complete brown pith discoloration throughout. The KB confirms "interior stem shows dark or light brown discoloration in the pith area."

All other candidates were eliminated:

- Bacterial_Wilt: showed cross-section in water (streaming test), different context
- Sclerotinia, Southern_Blight: external bleached lesions
- Late_Blight: dark external stem lesion
- Gray_Mold, Alternaria: microscope views

- Leaf diseases (TSWV, Early_Blight, CMV, Bacterial_Speck, Leaf_Mold): wrong plant part
